newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed ahead of ECI.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed ahead of ECI.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in moderate trade on Tuesday, dealers said.
They said most traders were sidelined ahead of tonight's release of the U.S. second quarter employment cost index (ECI) and July consumer confidence index data.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning except for some light activity at the short end. Some traders were waiting for fresh clues to market direction from tonight's release of the employment cost index and (July) consumer confidence index figures," a local dealer said.
"But I don't think there will be much inpact unless the numbers are way off market expectations," he said.

In day-to-day rates, Tuesday/Wednesday was unchanged from Monday's 5-9/16 5-7/16 percent, Wednesday/Thursday rose 1/8 percentage point to 5-11/16 5-9/16 and week-fixed was unchanged at 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent.

Among longer dates, one-month eased 1/16 point to 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent, three-months was unchanged at 5-11/16 5-9/16, nine-months unchanged at 5-7/8 5-3/4 and twelve-months unchanged at 5-15/16 5-13/16 percent.
